{{Quote|Probe droid. Very unusual&hellip; not like anything I've seen before.|[[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]]|<ref name="SWE1" />}}
The '''DRK-1 probe droid''', also known as '''Sith probe droid''', was a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] employed by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Characteristics==
{{Listen3|DarkEyeProbeDroids-TPM.flac|DRK-1 probe droids}}
[[File:Sith_Probe_Droid_SFB.png|thumb|left|220px|Side, front and rear view of a DRK-1 probe droid.]]
Developed by [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]], the DRK-1 [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] was a small, spherical automaton equipped with sophisticated [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] and communications packages. The design dated back centuries to early Sith probe droid models based on schematics provided by [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocrons]]. The DRK-1 version featured a trio of imaging sensors: a central [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptor]], a magnetic imaging device, and a thermal imager. An antenna atop the DRK-1's dome allowed its master to relay commands to the probot, programming it to seek out individuals or information. Data was then sent back to headquarters via the transmission antennae.

Sith probe droids were designed as passive spy units, and were plated with energy-absorbing stealth armor that baffled most sensor scans. However, weaponry could be mounted on the DRK-1 in many configurations, the most common being a miniaturized [[Grenade launcher/Legends|grenade launcher]]. Armaments adopted by the Sith included [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] cannons, [[Stun blaster/Legends|stun blasters]], and dart launchers loaded with poison needles.

==History==
[[File:DRK-1_Deployment.png|thumb|left|220px|Darth Maul's DRK-1 probe droids being deployed on Tatooine.]]
DRK-1 probe droids were commonly seen in the years prior to the [[Ruusan campaign]]. [[Standard century/Legends|Centuries]] later, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] carried three DRK-1 probe droids aboard the [[Scimitar/Legends|''Scimitar'']] during his time as the apprentice of [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]]. Maul recreated these spherical robots using the most disparate, off-the-shelf pieces. He also used his probots to spy on a [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] meeting on [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]], and later used them to track down [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], where the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] struck down one of the spying probes. The act resulted in a misunderstanding that cost the life of [[Pa'lowick/Legends|Pa'lowick]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Aneesa Dym]] at the hands of Maul.

Following Maul's presumed<ref name="TCW survival">As of the episode [[Brothers (episode)|Brothers]] in ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'', Maul was revealed to have survived his duel with Obi-Wan on Naboo.</ref> death at the hands of [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], the Sith Infiltrator, presumably along with the last two remaining probe droids, was taken into custody on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].

The DRK-1 closely resembled the [[R-1 recon droid]], which were used by snipers from the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] to the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], many [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] found droids of this model very useful and effective in tracking their prey throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. However, because of their size and communications range, they were only useful in planetary surface tracking.

==Behind the scenes==
The DRK-1 probe droids first appeared with the release of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']] and its tie-ins.

The [[IM series]] droid from the [[Tokyo Disneyland]] version of ''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'' bore a strong resemblance to the DRK-1 in terms of design.
